# RUNCARD rehearsal1013  phase=rsweep  SIM  (generated by rig/rig_runcard.py; $py = C:\Users\brets\Documents\Repositories\PythonIntanAnalysis\.venv\Scripts\python.exe)
# Every PowerShell: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process Bypass; $py = 'C:\Users\brets\Documents\Repositories\PythonIntanAnalysis\.venv\Scripts\python.exe'
# Terminal A = cpp_controller, terminal B = 2_loop (recording LAST, stim enable ON at 'go').

# ---------------- TIER C 6e -- interleaved R sweep in ONE run: R in {100 30 10}, 20-event blocks ----------------
# build the per-block schedule (needs a ref with blocks = k * levels, e.g. --events 120 for 3 levels x 20):
& $py rig\build_r_schedule.py --schedule day_rehearsal1013\schedule_mix_r1.json --block-events 20 --r 100 30 10 --m 4 --out day_rehearsal1013\rsched_r1.csv
# A:
.\cpp_controller.exe --mode mpc --model day_rehearsal1013\plant_duty.lti --output-count 8 --pairs 1,3,4,6 --feature-map 34,40 --q-weight 1e12,1e12 --r-weight 100,100 --r-schedule day_rehearsal1013\rsched_r1.csv --control-horizon 20 --umin 0 --umax 30 --reference day_rehearsal1013\ref_mix_r1.csv --capture day_rehearsal1013\capture_mpc_rsweep_r1.csv --max-packets 22200
# B:
.\rig\2_loop.ps1 -Sim -InputChannels 64 -TimeoutMs 10 -TickFrames 6 -Run mpc_rsweep_r1 -Ticks 22200 -Capture day_rehearsal1013\capture_mpc_rsweep_r1.csv
& $py rig\run_audit.py --run mpc_rsweep_r1 --loop-log loop_runmpc_rsweep_r1.log --capture day_rehearsal1013\capture_mpc_rsweep_r1.csv --ref day_rehearsal1013\ref_mix_r1.csv --sim
& $py rig\analyze_r_sweep.py --capture day_rehearsal1013\capture_mpc_rsweep_r1.csv --ref day_rehearsal1013\ref_mix_r1.csv --rsched day_rehearsal1013\rsched_r1.json --y-channels 34 40 --u-channels 1 3 4 6 --hold 0 --lat day_rehearsal1013\server_lat_capture_mpc_rsweep_r1.csv --json day_rehearsal1013\rsweep_r1.json --png day_rehearsal1013\rsweep_r1.png
& $py rig\ingest_block.py --label "mpc R-sweep r1 arm" --mode arm --schedule day_rehearsal1013\schedule_mix_r1.json --day rehearsal1013
